# Contract: repo-timelapse

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: video. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Git history visualised as a growing file treemap with dates, line counts and commit captions.

## Use it for
- "timelapse of my repo"
- "video of how the project grew"

## Not for
- measure product success from commits (not what this shows)

## Accepted inputs
A local git repository the user owns or may show.

## Deliverables
history.json, history.messages.txt (for review), preview/final mp4, stills.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+
- Git
- Node.js 18.19+
- Playwright npm package (npm install)
- Playwright Chromium binary (npx playwright install chromium, ~150-200 MB)
- ffmpeg (on PATH or FFMPEG)

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Local only: reads and writes files on this machine.

## Cost-sensitive operations
Local rendering time only.

## Workflow
1. Extract and read the report
2. Pick the story
3. Clean the noise
4. Preview
5. Render the final
6. Report

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Which arc and range
- Review every commit message before export; anonymise or redact

## Quality checks
- Extract report read before rendering
- messages.txt reviewed
- preview watched

## Common failures
- Bulk imports dominate the map
- Private text in commit messages

## Limitations
- Lines of code and commits show activity, not success

## Reproducible example
The SumitCraft repo itself, anonymised, with a redaction rule (evidence/repo-timelapse).
